exposure: Sequential low dose oral misoprostol solution for labor induction
cohort: 128 women with a term singleton pregnancy and a Bishop score of 6 or less who underwent labor induction at Siriraj Hospital
finding: The sequential low dose misoprostol solution protocol resulted in a 92.2% cervical ripening rate and a 54.7% vaginal delivery rate, with multiparity and birth weight less than 3200 grams significantly associated with successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Successful vaginal delivery was achieved in 70 cases (54.7%).
